title: The observability research answers JSON logs to stdout for the Collector, Loki, Tempo and Grafana but not for the corpus service's own Python and Rust code
goal: The kb answers how a Python and a Rust service write JSON log lines to stdout from their official docs (Python logging or a documented formatter, Rust tracing-subscriber's JSON format), in logs/otel-collector-otlp-pipeline.md or a linked article, or a _gaps.md entry records what is unpublished (found by the SP-qjn563cf review).

run: import pathlib,sys; sys.exit(not any('tracing-subscriber' in p.read_text() for p in pathlib.Path('kb/public').rglob('*.md')))

repro_reason: a missing fact in kb articles: no tool behaviour to run, only the articles' text

run: import pathlib,sys; t=[l.lower() for f in list(pathlib.Path('kb/public/logs').glob('*.md'))+[pathlib.Path('kb/public/_gaps.md')] for l in f.read_text().splitlines()]; py=any('python' in l and 'logging' in l and 'json' in l and 'stdout' in l for l in t); rs=any('tracing-subscriber' in l and 'json' in l for l in t); sys.exit(0 if py and rs else 1)
